name: HOMERIZ
recent: Homeritz Corporation Berhad 近期出现董事及主要股东在公开市场出售股份的申报，同时有一项未指明内容的「OTHERS」公告。公司也发布了截至2026年8月31日止季度的业绩报告。
notable: 董事 Chua Fen Fatt 与执行董事 Tee Hwee Ing 于2026年9月1日合计出售242,900股普通股，占已发行股本0.053%。
公司于2026年9月9日发布一项「OTHERS」公告，内容未在提供的资料中说明。
risks: 董事 Chua Fen Fatt 与执行董事 Tee Hwee Ing 于2026年9月1日出售公司股份。

recent_en: Homeritz Corporation Berhad recently saw filings of share disposals by directors and a substantial shareholder in the open market, along with an 'OTHERS' announcement with unspecified content. The company also released its quarterly results for the period ended 31 August 2026.
notable_en: Director Chua Fen Fatt and Executive Director Tee Hwee Ing disposed a total of 242,900 ordinary shares on 1 September 2026, representing 0.053% of issued share capital.
The company issued an 'OTHERS' announcement on 9 September 2026, with details not specified in the provided information.
risks_en: Director Chua Fen Fatt and Executive Director Tee Hwee Ing disposed shares of the company on 1 September 2026.
